shared_rules.layout: header (brand left / index pill / date right) + cyan rule y92 + unified title area [104,422] (block vertically centered) + divider y430 + speaker y450 + bottom row y540 h44 (time pill left / status badge right)
shared_rules.title_wrap: punctuation-segment packing (split at ：，、。；！？/) with atom-wrap fallback and orphan-tail rebalance
shared_rules.text_emission: text="..." attribute (verified to pass raw < > & through; element content would PARSE_ERROR on raw '<')
shared_rules.no_per_card_hardcode: single parameterized generator; the only branches are data-driven (length and status), identical parameters for all 8

length_branches.title_font: first size in [56,50,46,42,40,38,36] whose wrapped line count <= 3; if none fits, use 36 + truncate last line with ellipsis + warning (never below 36)
length_branches.speaker: wrap at 640px / 26px; >2 lines -> keep 2 + ellipsis + warning
length_branches.unknown_status: color #94A3B8, symbol ◆, badge '<symbol> <status>' + warning (branch not triggered by real input)
length_branches.cancelled: status == '取消' -> additional solid annotation pill '✕ 本场取消' left of the badge; card keeps full color/title/time (data-driven, triggers on K06)

anomaly_probe_K99.covers: unknown status neutral encoding + warning, time 900 int -> str coercion, long title shrink 56->38, long speaker 2 lines

truncation_probe_K98.covers: extreme title -> shrink to 36 + ellipsis truncation + warning, 3 lines, no overflow

text_special_cases_in_real_input.note: real input contains no newline; newline handling of the shared text emission was exercised by pre-pivot wall probe (tmp/run-20261011-01/A14/drafts/probe-newline*.snapshot, real \n breaks line in both text-attr and element-content forms)

text_preservation_check.method: programmatic string equality of displayed (newline-stripped) vs inputs/cards.json for title/speaker/time/status on all 8 cards
